examples.japanese: ⟦{国債|こくさい}→国債：12016_kokusai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{償還|しょうかん}{期限|きげん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: The redemption date for the government bonds has arrived.

examples.english: To redeem corporate bonds at maturity.

notes:
{償還|しょうかん} is a financial term referring to the repayment or redemption of bonds and other financial instruments, typically at their maturity date.

WRITING:
- {償|しょう} (compensate, repay)
- {還|かん} (return, give back)

USAGE:
- {償還|しょうかん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to redeem, to repay - suru verb)
- {償還|しょうかん}{期限|きげん}/{償還|しょうかん}{日|び} (redemption date)
- {償還|しょうかん}{金|きん} (redemption payment)

TYPES:
- {満期|まんき}{償還|しょうかん} (redemption at maturity)
- ⟦{繰|く}り{上|あ}げ→繰り上げる：07007_kuriageru⟧{償還|しょうかん} (early redemption)
- ⟦{一部|いちぶ}→一部：06783_ichibu⟧{償還|しょうかん} (partial redemption)
- {全額|ぜんがく}{償還|しょうかん} (full redemption)

COMMON OBJECTS:
- ⟦{国債|こくさい}→国債：12016_kokusai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{償還|しょうかん} (government bond redemption)
- ⟦{社債|しゃさい}→社債：24079_shasai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{償還|しょうかん} (corporate bond redemption)
- ⟦{借入金|かりいれきん}→借入金：29454_kariirekin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{償還|しょうかん} (loan repayment)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{返済|へんさい}→返済：04776_hensai⟧ - general repayment (loans)
- {償還|しょうかん} - specifically for bonds and securities

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{返済|へんさい}→返済：04776_hensai⟧ (repayment)
- ⟦{弁済|べんさい}→弁済：08008_bensai⟧ (repayment, reimbursement)
- ⟦{元本|がんぽん}→元本：07072_ganpon⟧ (principal)
- {満期|まんき} (maturity)
